confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief to confirm whether LH-03 is stopped or operating. The radio and CMMS disagree, so nothing moves there until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-02 is down at E569-07 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 13:30. LH-10 is idle at the workshop and 0.49 h away. At 27.5 t/h (LH410) it clears the 164 t at 10.5 gpt in about 6 h, which is roughly 55 oz. Este's stockpile is nearly empty (48 of 450 t) and its trucks carry 72 t/h, so Este is not truck-limited. No development loader is taken and no producing stope loses its loader. A reserve can't be activated because no stope has stopped. LH-03 is left alone under CONFIRM-01.
